paite: Ahihleh Pathian in amite apaikhia a hia? Paikhe lou hial! Kei leng Israel mi, Abraham suan Benjamin nam ka hi ngal a.
heading: Israelte Paihkhiakdet Hilou
english: I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

paite: Pathian in ami a theihkholhte apaikhe kei hi. Laisiangthou in Elijah thu agen na thei kei ua hia? Ama'n Israel mite tungthu Pathian kiang ah atun a,
english: God didn’t reject his people, whom he foreknew. Or don’t you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads with God against Israel:

paite: "Toupa na zawlneite athat ua, na maitamte ahihchim ua; keimah kia nutsiat in ka om, kei leng hihlup ahon tum uhi," achih.
english: “Lord, they have killed your prophets. They have broken down your altars. I am left alone, and they seek my life.”

paite: Himahleh Pathian in bangchi in adawng a? "Baal ma a khukdin ngeiloumi sangsagih keimah a ding in ka hawi hi,” chi in adawng hi.
english: But how does God answer him? “I have reserved for myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal.”

paite: Huchibang in tulai in leng akhosuaksun, hehpihna a tel a-om uhi.
english: Even so too at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

paite: Hehpihna ziak ahihleh, nasep ziak ahita kei, huchi hi keileh, hehpihna tuh hehpihna ahita kei ding.
english: And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.

paite: Bangchi ahita dia le? Israel mite'n azon uh amu kei uh. Telte'n bel amu ua, adangte tengteng ananggawpta uhi.
english: What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn’t obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.

paite: "Pathian in tuni tan in akiang uah lusukna kha apia a, muh theihlouhna mitte, zak theihlouhna bilte toh," chih gelh bang in.
english: According as it is written, “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, to this very day.”

paite: David in, "Adohkan uh amau a ding in thang leh pial, pukna leh phulakna hong hi hen;
english: David says, “Let their table be made a snare, a trap, a stumbling block, and a retribution to them.

paite: Amuh theihlouhna ding un amitte uh hong mial hen, nang anungzang uh kunsak gige in," achi hi.
english: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see. Always keep their backs bent.”

paite: Ahihleh akisuih uh akipukdetna ding uhia? Hilou hial! Apuk ziak un Zentelte kiang ah hotdamna ahong tung zawta hi; Israel mite hazatsakna ding in.
english: I ask then, did they stumble that they might fall? May it never be! But by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.

paite: Huchi in apukna uh bawn khovel hih hauhsakna ahih a, akiamna uh leng Zentelte hauhsakna ahihleh, abuchin nawnna uh bangchi phet a hamphatna lianzaw in azui diam aw!
english: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles, how much more their fullness!

paite: Huchi in nou Zentelte kiang ah ka gen ahi. Kei Zentelte kiang a sawltak ka hih ziak in, ka nasepna pen ka pahtawi ahi.
heading: Israelte Pukna Ziak A Zentelte Hamphatna
english: For I speak to you who are Gentiles. Since then as I am an apostle to Gentiles, I glorify my ministry,

paite: Huchi a ka chipihte ka hazatsak theih teiteina ding leh alak ua khenkhatte ka hotdam theihna ding in.
english: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy those who are my flesh, and may save some of them.

paite: Amau paihkhiakna bawn khovel toh kituah nawnna ahihleh, amau deih nawnna ding sihna a kipan hin nawnna lou ngal bang ahi dia?
english: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?

paite: Huan gah masa thillat, tangbuang mekthem asianthouleh huchi mah bang in abeupi asiangthou hi; azungpi asianthouleh ahiangte leng huchi mah bang ahi uhi.
english: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.

paite: Hiang khenkhatte hihtan a a-om in, nang, olive tak lou, amaute lak a phuhlut a na om a, olive sing a hauhna zung kikoppih sam na hihman in,
english: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them and became partaker with them of the root and of the richness of the olive tree,

paite: hiang dangte lak ah kisathei ke'n. Kisathei mah lechin nang azung vakpa na hi kei a, huai azung pen nang hon vakpa ahi zaw hi.
english: don’t boast over the branches. But if you boast, remember that it is not you who support the root, but the root supports you.

paite: Huan nang, "Phuhlut a ka omtheihna ding in hiangte hihtan in a-om khinta vo oi," na chi dia.
english: You will say then, “Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.”

paite: Ahi agintaklouhna ziak un hihtan in a-om ua, nang na ginna ziak in na dingh ahi, uang ke'nla, lau zaw in.
english: True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don’t be conceited, but fear;

paite: Pathian in hiangtakte pen bawn ahawi kei ngalleh nang leng ahon hawi tuan kei ding hi.
english: for if God didn’t spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.

paite: Huchi in Pathian hoihna leh athukhauhna ngaihtuah in; apukte a ding a athukhauhna; nang a ding in bel ahoihna, hoihna a na om gigeleh; huchi ahihkeileh nang leng satkhiak in na om sam ding.
english: See then the goodness and severity of God. Toward those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness; otherwise you also will be cut off.

paite: Huan amau leng gingta lou a a-om nilouh kei uleh, phuhlut in a-om nawn ding uh; Pathian in amaute aphutlut nawn thei hi.
english: They also, if they don’t continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.

paite: Nang piandan a olive tak lou a kipan a satsup bawn, piandan lou bang a olive sing hoih a phuhlut a na omleh, tua ahiangtakte, amau olive sing ngei ah phuhlut hi na tel un chia!
english: For if you were cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree, and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree, how much more will these, which are the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?

paite: Unaute aw, hiai thuguk na theih louh uh ka ut kei a, huchi lou in zaw na kipilsak ding uh; Zentelte buchinna ahong tun masiah Israel mi khenkhatte tung ah siatna ahong tung tadih hi.
heading: Israelte Hotdam A Om Ding
english: For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in,

paite: Huchi in Israel mi tengteng hotdam in a-om ding uh: "Zion a kipan in Hondampa ahong suak ding a, Jakob kiang a kipan Pathian limsaklouhna ahihmang ding,"
english: and so all Israel will be saved. Even as it is written, “There will come out of Zion the Deliverer, and he will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.

paite: "Akiang ua ka thukhun ding hiai ahi, akhelhnate uh ka lakmang chiang in," chih gelh bang in.
english: This is my covenant with them, when I will take away their sins.”

paite: Tanchinhoih lam ngaihtuah in, nou ziak in melma ahi ua; tel thu lam ngaihtuah in bel apipute uh ziak in deihtakte ahi uhi.
english: Concerning the Good News, they are enemies for your sake. But concerning the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sake.

paite: Pathian in athilthawnpiak ah leh asapna ah alungsim akhel ngei kei hi.
english: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.

paite: Nidanglai in Pathian thu na gingta kei ua, himahleh tu in amau agin louh ziak un zahngaihna na mu ngal ua.
english: For as you in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,

paite: Huchi mah bang in tu in, Pathian in nou ahon hehpihna ziak a, zahngaihna amuhtheihna ding un amau leng ging lou ahita ve ua.
english: even so these also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy.

paite: Pathian in azahngaih vek theihna ding in ginlouhna ah mi tengteng akhumvekta hi.
english: For God has bound all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.

paite: Pathian pilna leh theihna hauhdan thuk hi na tel e! Avaihawm-nate theihtheih vual leh alampite sui zoh vual hi kei na tel e!
heading: Pathian Pahtawina
english: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!

paite: "Toupa lungsim kua'n ahia thei? ahihkeileh kua ahia ama thuhilhmi?
english: “For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”

paite: Ahihkeileh adit nawn ding a leng akiang ah kua'n ahia thil pe masa?"
english: “Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?”

paite: Amah a kipan leh amah ziak leh amah a ding a thil tengteng ahong om ahi ngal a; amah kiang ah tangtawn in thupina om hen. Amen.
english: For of him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.
